_meta.source: GET https://api.llama.fi/protocols (filter category=="Prediction Market", plus category=="Interface" rows whose name/dimension key contains "predict"); GET https://api.llama.fi/overview/{dexs,fees,open-interest}?excludeTotalDataChart=true&excludeTotalDataChartBreakdown=true (joined by name)
limitations: open-interest "latest" is the dimension 24h field, not a 30d sum; do not sum it
volumes are adapter-reported; methodology differs per venue (see docs/research/09 section 1)
chains[] empty for off-chain venues (Kalshi, Polymarket US, XO Market, MagicMarkets) even when the venue has its own chain
descriptions/logos intentionally omitted; DefiLlama repos carry no licence file (GitHub API license=null), API is keyless
